description:
Captured from the JMAP-g7wu.2.4.11 design conversation (2026-05-11, Mark).

The current draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 has exactly one place where group-chat administration is referenced — §Chat pinned messages list, line 459: 'For group chats, only admins may modify this list.' The 'admins' concept is not defined elsewhere in the draft.

## What is missing

  - Definition of 'admin' for Chat with `kind: "group"`
  - Whether the creator is automatically an admin
  - Mechanism (if any) to add/remove admins
  - Distinction (if any) between admin and owner
  - Interaction with the federation draft (cross-server group chats: where does admin authority live, how do remote servers enforce it, what happens when the admin's home server is unreachable)
  - Removal protection (analogous to Space's 'owner cannot be removed')
  - Destroy semantics (who can destroy a group chat)

## Why this was deferred

The JMAP-g7wu.2.4.11 conversation considered broadening the Space.ownerId pattern to Chat. The decision was NO because:

  1. Group chat permission model is one off-hand reference — much less developed than Space's permission model
  2. Industry-precedent split (WhatsApp multi-admin vs Discord single-creator vs Signal democratic) means the right shape needs design judgment, not a cookie-cutter from Space
  3. Federation interactions (per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation) are unresolved for cross-server admin enforcement
  4. Adding Chat.ownerId alone without resolving the 'admins' concept would create two parallel concepts that conflict

## What this bead does NOT do

It does NOT block the JMAP crate workspace shipping. The line 459 'admins' reference will be tightened to an explicit 'implementation-defined' marker in the next draft revision (covered in JMAP-g7wu.2.4.11's spec text edits). The crate workspace's chat-types crate carries no group-chat admin field today; if the future spec adds one, the crate work follows.

## Acceptance

  - Next draft-atwood-jmap-chat revision (likely -01) contains a full definition of group chat permission semantics covering admins, ownership (if applicable), federation interactions, removal protection, and destroy semantics.
  - Line 459 'admins' reference resolves to the new definition (or is replaced).
  - Workspace JMAP-g7wu.2.4 chat Space/set work continues to ship in parallel against the current draft; no dependency on this bead.

## Scope

Spec-author work only. No code changes in this workspace until the spec lands.

LABELS: human (Mark's spec-author task; not workspace code work)
